headline: Foreign Outflow Rp 45 B in Session I, 10 Stocks Heavily Sold
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index rose 0.39% to 5,341.61 in the morning session on 17 November 2026. Foreign investors recorded net selling of Rp45 billion, with ten stocks seeing heavy disposals.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is Indonesia's main equity benchmark, and foreign flows are a key gauge of international investor sentiment toward the country.
original_headline: Dana Asing Keluar Rp 45 M di Sesi I, 10 Saham Ini Banyak Dilepas
